content: निवृत्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Returned, turned back. .²2 Gone, departed, vanished, disappeared. .²3 Ceased, refrained or abstained from, stopped, desisted; तस्थौ निवृत्तान्यवराभिलाषः <ls>Ku. 1. 51</ls>. .²4 Abstaining from worldly acts, abstracted from this world, quiet; प्रवृत्तं च निवृत्तं च द्विविधं कर्म वैदिकम् <ls>Ms. 12. 88</ls>. .²5 Repenting of improper conduct. .²6 Finished, completed, whole; .²7 Set (as the sun); see वृत् with नि. .{@-त्तम्@} .²1 Return. .²2 A mind free from the influence of passions.
